The following events took place in '''400 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Battles==
*The [[Battle of Sintheti]] went on for a second year.<ref name="EGTWACp2" />

==Events==
*[[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The elitist [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Nomad's Retreat]] in the [[Nomad Mountains]] expanded its membership to become a public resort.
*[[Susevfi]] was settled by [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] expatriates.
*[[Beldorion]] traveled to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Dyspeth]] was rediscovered by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] survey team. {{Circa}}<ref name="LECG" />
*The ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' is constructed.<ref name="FF95">{{FactFile|95|CHU 1-2|''Chu'unthor''}}</ref>
*Written history begins on [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] {{Circa}}<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
